Synopsis:
    Australia has deployed a 15-member disaster response team — primarily drone specialists from state emergency services — to Nepal following catastrophic Himalayan floods triggered by a glacier collapse on August 26. Over 1,200 are confirmed dead and ~5,000 remain missing, including 36 Australian nationals. Seven Australian Federal Police forensic identification specialists are also being sent. Survivor odds are fading but search operations continue.
